Malicious Supply-Chain Indicators

No confirmed malicious supply-chain indicators.

Automatic Execution Paths

  • In the provided file contents, there is no evidence of .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, clearly malicious install-time build hooks, or import-time malicious side effects.
  • The pre-scan notes that setup.py exists in the artifact, but its contents were not included in the supplied corpus, so install-time behavior could not be verified.
  • src/python_pop/install/mcp_launcher.py contains a launcher template that writes .python-pop/mcp-launcher.py and searches for a python_pop mcp runtime. Based on the provided evidence, this appears to be user-triggered functional code, not install-time or interpreter-start automatic execution.
  • Potential console_scripts/CLI behavior was not treated as malicious automatic execution because it requires user invocation.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Stealth

  • **Credential harvesting:** No evidence of broad environment variable scraping, .env, SSH keys, cloud credentials, CI tokens, wallets, or kube config discovery.
  • **Archive staging / exfiltration:** No evidence of tar/zip/gzip/base64 staging of secrets or outbound upload.
  • The api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com access in github_skill_provider.py appears to implement remote “skill” discovery/download functionality. It includes destination path validation (_safe_destination) and provenance recording. The provided code does not support classifying this as C2 or exfiltration.
  • base64.b64decode(args.arguments) in execute_tool.py appears to decode CLI JSON arguments. There is no accompanying eval, exec, compile, or dynamic payload loader evidence.
  • **Persistence:** No evidence of systemd units, launch agents, cron jobs, shell profile edits, startup folder registration, or background polling loops.
  • **Lateral movement:** No evidence of Kubernetes service-account use, Docker socket access, cloud metadata access, GitHub Actions token theft, or workflow injection.
  • **Obfuscation/loader:** Aside from regex usage and base64 argument decoding, there is no evidence of obfuscated payloads, staged downloaders, or marshal/pickle/eval/exec loaders.

Distribution Integrity Anomalies

  • .ai/.../*.md and SKILL.md files are present under hidden paths, but their contents appear to be framework-specific AI guidance/skill documents consistent with the package purpose. No executable hidden payload or malicious logic was identified.
  • No evidence was found in the provided corpus of unexplained native binaries, hidden executable payloads, sudden dependency insertion, typosquatting, or wheel/sdist mismatch.

Additional Verification Needed

  • setup.py, pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, MANIFEST.in, and the full SOURCES.txt contents were not included in the supplied corpus, so full install-time and packaging metadata review remains necessary.
  • Only 25 selected files out of 160 were available for review; the full artifact should be checked for .pth, sitecustomize.py, native binaries, or hidden executable payloads.
